Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in its initial analysis of the search results. It incorrectly identified the 2004 film *The Prince & Me* as the film where Kam Heskin plays Paige Morgan. The search results explicitly stated that Julia Stiles played the role in the 2004 film, while Kam Heskin took over the role in the 2006 sequel, *The Prince & Me 2: The Royal Wedding*. By ignoring this distinction and concluding the answer was the director of the 2004 film (Catherine Cyran), the Planner failed to identify the correct film (*The Prince & Me 2*) and its director (Martha Coolidge).
